title: Determination of Gold in Gold Bullion, Gold Alloys and Gold Jewellery/Artefacts - Cupellation (Fire Assay) Method
clause_1_scope: This standard prescribes the cupellation or fire assay method for assaying of gold in gold bullion, gold alloys, and gold jewellery/artefacts covered in IS 1417.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Gold and Gold Alloys, Jewellery/Artefacts - Fineness and Marking

clause_3_terminology: Determination of Gold in Gold Bullion

chemical_properties: lead foil, bead have been kept at 09,9 percent
Purity of lead foil, bead have been kept at 09,9 percent
marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
